items.item_text: Possession of a Clinical Social Worker License issued by the California Board of Behavioral Sciences Examiners.
Masters Degree in Social Work from an accredited School of Social Work.
Experience reviewing and evaluating clinical documentation and coaching staff on quality improvement activities through direct observations.
Previous QI experience and ability to perform analyses and report results
Previous experience with teaching or training others (e.g. clinicians, students, practitioners) in areas related to mental health identification or treatment.
2 years Social Work experience in correctional setting.
Thorough knowledge and experience completing biopsychosocial assessments and determining diagnosis according to DSM-5 TR.

The LCSW will assist with behavioral health clinical training programs, participate in Quality Improvement (QI) studies, complete clinical audits of mental services, attend QI subcommittee meetings and train and coach staff regarding clinical documentation, social work practice issues and audit and QI results.
Advanced skills in Windows-based software programs (Word, Excel, Power Point, etc.).
